theme: reviewing personality, appearance and present-time language through evidence
can_do: Choose a personality adjective from a short action-based clue.
Ask and answer deterministic questions about a fictional person's visible features.
Build affirmative and negative present-continuous verb phrases.
Distinguish a repeated habit from an action happening at the moment of speaking.
Combine vocabulary and grammar evidence in a short final review.

language_focus.function: infer one personality adjective from a concrete action or repeated behaviour
identify a fictional character or answer yes/no from explicit profile evidence
combine the correct form of be with a verb ending in ing
select tense from meaning and time markers before choosing the verb form

common_errors: choose an attractive adjective without matching the action clue
mix appearance information with personality information
omit the form of be before a verb ending in ing
use the wrong be form for a plural or singular subject
forget the third-person singular ending in a repeated habit
use the present continuous with a daily habit marker
change word order incorrectly in a present-continuous question

activity_slots.purpose: Select a personality adjective from an original action-based clue.
Answer who- and yes-no questions from safe fictional profile cards.
Complete affirmative and negative present-continuous verb phrases.
Choose present simple or present continuous and the matching verb form.
Mix personality, appearance and tense evidence in a deterministic end-of-unit challenge.

pedagogy_constraints: Teach the evidence-to-answer routine before the first game.
Keep every round deterministic with one visible correct answer.
Use fictional profiles instead of asking learners to identify or describe real classmates.
Explain tense choice from meaning before focusing on spelling.
Accept full and contracted negative forms as equivalent in explanations, while keeping one displayed answer per multiple-choice round.
Give each game source-aware help, ten rounds, keyboard-accessible controls and transparent feedback.
originality_constraints: Do not reuse source character names, sentences, dialogue wording, classroom scene or page layout in a commercial version.
Create all new clues, fictional profiles, grammar contexts, distractors and feedback from this clean brief only.
Do not reproduce, crop, trace or imitate the source illustration.
Use Vietnamese two-word names for every newly designed character.
Keep source-derived personal-family lesson items separate from clean-brief commercial content.
